additionalProbes.meaning: These probes assert and confirm existing defects; passed does not mean the behavior meets the specification.

observations.case: Same timestamp, sequence 1 then 2, UUID of sequence 2 sorts before sequence 1
observations.actual: Both WebStore.list() and listDirect() return sequence [2, 1]

observations.case: Register demo identity with original secret, reset signaling service state, register same ID with a different secret
observations.actual: Second claimant receives ok=true and a relay token

observations.case: Close MessageDelivery while waiting for ACK, ACK timeout configured to 30 ms
observations.actual: Send promise still pending after 80 ms; persisted status remains sent

observations.case: Owner removes itself from a two-member demo group, remaining member attempts to add a peer
observations.actual: Owner removal succeeds; remaining member rejected with only owner can add member

browserAndInternet.limitations: The tsx CLI hit os.userInfo()/uv_os_get_passwd ENOMEM in the restricted runtime. Isolated server probes used temporary esbuild bundles of unchanged source. Chrome CDP page/Runtime initialization timed out. A later shell launch reported insufficient disk space. These environment failures are not established application defects. Temporary test sources, bundles and browser profiles were removed.
